import numpy as np

def score_merge_static(distance_matrix, demands, capacity, i_idx, j_idx):
    """Return a 1D array of finite float priority scores (higher = merge earlier)."""
    i_idx = np.asarray(i_idx, dtype=np.int64)
    j_idx = np.asarray(j_idx, dtype=np.int64)
    d = np.asarray(distance_matrix, dtype=np.float64)
    q = np.asarray(demands, dtype=np.float64)

    n = d.shape[0] - 1
    d0 = d[0, 1:n + 1]
    scale = float(np.mean(d0)) if n > 0 else 1.0
    if not np.isfinite(scale) or scale <= 0.0:
        scale = 1.0

    d0i = d[0, i_idx]
    d0j = d[0, j_idx]
    dij = d[i_idx, j_idx]

    lam = 1.02
    mu = 0.14
    beta = 0.13
    gamma = 0.06

    saving = d0i + d0j - lam * dij
    asym = mu * np.abs(d0i - d0j)

    qi = q[i_idx]
    qj = q[j_idx]
    qsum = qi + qj
    fill = np.clip(qsum / capacity, 0.0, 1.0)
    fill2 = fill * fill

    eps = 1e-12
    balance = 1.0 - np.abs(qi - qj) / (qsum + eps)

    score = (saving + asym) / scale + beta * fill + gamma * fill2 + 0.04 * balance
    score = np.where(np.isfinite(score), score, -1e30)
    return score.astype(np.float64)
